Afonso III [ 1 ] [ a ] ( Afonso Afonso ; 5 May 1210 – 16 February 1279), called the Boulonnais ( Port. o Bolonhês ), was King of Portugal and the first to use the title King of Portugal and the Algarve , from 1249. He was the second son of King Afonso II of Portugal and Urraca of Castile ; he succeeded his brother, King Sancho II of Portugal , who died on 4 January 1248. [ 2 ]
